I am a Ph.D. candidate in the Department of Electrical Engineering at National Taiwan University, advised by Prof. Wanjiun Liao. Since February 2026 I have been a visiting researcher at the University of Oulu, Finland, working with Prof. Mehdi Bennis.

I worked as an engineer at TSMC and ASMedia, on semiconductor design workflows and high-speed USB4 IP solutions. I hold an M.S. in Computer Science and Information Engineering from National Chung Cheng University and a B.S. in Computer Science and Engineering from Yuan Ze University.
